attachment.$description: Attachments in the feed and the composer (slice 7): the album, the file card, the pending tiles, the drop overlay, the lightbox.

album-max-height.$description: Tallest a single photo goes in the feed. A photo is content, not text, so the size is in px and does not grow with the text scale.

album-max-width.$description: Widest an album or a file card goes: the inner width of the widest bubble. The same width is used by the grid and the file card, so every attachment of an entry shares one column.

album-gap.$description: Gap between the cells of an album grid.

album-radius.$description: Corners of a photo, a grid cell, a file card and a pending tile.

pixel.$description: One image pixel on screen: a single photo is never drawn larger than its own pixel size (width * pixel).

cell-aspect-1.$description: Width / height of the cell of a row with one photo (16:9). Which rows an album has is in ui/attachments/albumRows.ts.

cell-aspect-2.$description: Width / height of a cell in a row of two photos (4:3).

cell-aspect-3.$description: Width / height of a cell in a row of three photos (square).

fallback-aspect.$description: Width / height of the box of a photo whose size is not known (4:3).

tile-text-padding.$description: Padding of the 'No preview' and 'File is missing' tile text.

file-padding.$description: Padding of a file card around the icon and the text.

file-gap.$description: Gap between the icon box and the text of a file card.

file-icon-box.$description: Side of the square under the icon of a file card (36 px at a 13 px root).

pending-size.$description: Side of a pending tile in the composer (58 px at a 13 px root); the height of a file tile.

pending-file-width.$description: Width of a pending file tile (169 px at a 13 px root).

pending-gap.$description: Gap between pending tiles; the row wraps.

pending-remove-offset.$description: Offset of the x button from the corner of a pending tile.

drop-inset.$description: How far the drop outline stands from the edge of the feed.

lightbox-padding.$description: Margin around the photo and the controls of the lightbox.

lightbox-gap.$description: Gap between the controls and the photo of the lightbox.

lightbox-percent-width.$description: Minimum width of the zoom percentage button in the lightbox toolbar (47 px at a 13 px root): fits '800%' so the buttons beside it do not move.

story-narrow-width.$description: Storybook only: the width of a narrow window in the attachment stories.

lightbox-scrim.$description: The backdrop of the lightbox: the window background colour with this opacity, nearly opaque so the photo stands alone.
